title: Number of Single Parents who Have Successfully Applied for HDB Flats under ASSIST
what_it_is: Number of Single Parents who Have Successfully Applied for HDB Flats under ASSIST

sections.label: ASSIST scheme for divorced widowed parents
sections.summary: ASSIST, introduced in May 2013, received 230 applications by May 2015, with 223 shortlisted and 85 seeking HDB financial assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Assistance Scheme for Second-Timers (Divorced/Widowed Parents), or ASSIST, was introduced in May 2013.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Up to May 2015, there were 230 applications from divorced or widowed parents under ASSIST.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: There are sufficient flats set aside for them each year, with 97%, or 223 of the 230 applicants, being successfully shortlisted to select a flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Eighty-five applicants under ASSIST had approached the Housing and Development Board (HDB) for financial assistance to purchase their flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB assesses the circumstances of each case and provides assistance wherever possible, for example, by incorporating the resale levy into the purchase price of the Build-To-Order (BTO) flat, so that the payments can be spread over a longer period of time.

sections.label: Rental housing for low-income parents
sections.summary: Low-income divorced or widowed parents with no housing options or family support may be allocated public rental flats or interim rental housing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Low-income divorced or widowed parents who have no housing options or family support may be allocated public rental flats or interim rental housing.

sections.label: Rental housing assistance in 2015
sections.summary: In 2015, about 800 divorced or widowed parents were assisted with rental housing, mostly public rental.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In 2015, about 800 divorced/widowed parents were assisted with various forms of rental housing, the majority being public rental.

sections.label: Incorporating resale levy into instalments
sections.summary: Wherever possible, the resale levy will be incorporated to spread it over a longer period, making monthly instalments more bearable.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For such cases, wherever possible, we will try to incorporate the resale levy just to spread it over a longer period, so that they will find the payment of the instalments much more bearable on a monthly basis.
